The Republic of South Africa''' (abbr. South Africa; ) is a country in the extreme southern Africa, proclaimed on 31 May 1961 following the. It lasted until 10 May 1994, when the came into force and Nelson Mandela became President of South Africa.
It bordered on Botswana and Zimbabwe to the north, on Mozambique and Swaziland to the northeast, and on the mandated South West Africa to the northwest.
